## Function

**IL10** encodes a cytokine that limits excessive inflammatory programs, including antigen-presentation and pro-inflammatory cytokine output, while supporting aspects of B-cell biology. Its receptor activates JAK–STAT signaling. The [NCBI Gene summary](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/3586) highlights its essential intestinal immunoregulatory role in knockout studies.

## How to read this study’s methylation signal

The presentation lists IL10 among hypomethylated immune genes in severe UC. That does not guarantee more IL10 RNA or protein: the result depends on CpG location, responding cell type, and immune-cell abundance. IL10 may rise as a compensatory brake during inflammation even when disease remains active.

<details><summary><strong>Measurements needed</strong></summary>

Resolve the DMR location, cell composition, IL10 transcript, circulating/local protein, and STAT3 pathway response before claiming functional activation.
</details>
